description:
**Phoebe Lux**

This custom skin brings Phoebe from Wuthering Waves into League of Legends.

Take control of Phoebe on the Rift and experience Lux through a full visual rework based on Wuthering Waves.

This skin delivers a luminous Phoebe-themed version of Lux with a complete visual identity, redesigned spell effects, and a custom static loading screen.

**Features**
- Reworked 3D model
- Custom Loading screen
- Modified ability icons
- Reworked ability VFX
- Official Japanese Wuthering Waves voicelines
- Custom animation adjustments

The skin will continue to evolve through future updates, so stay tuned.
